column1: # WORDS UPSTREAM'S OWN FLAT SURFACE RESOLVES TO A CLASS THEIR HAND-WRITTEN LAYER DECLARES.
# Derived from upstream 9.6.1's own `src/adcp/types/_eager.py` -- the module their
# `adcp/types/__init__.py` resolves every flat `__getattr__` through, so it IS the authority
# for what a flat word means on their wheel. A word bound there from `_generated`, `domains.**`,
# `aliases` or `_forward_compat` names a GENERATED class and the alias is owed; a word bound
# from any OTHER module of theirs names a class their hand-written layer declares, and
# `_forward_compat` is excluded from the hand-written side because it re-exports the generated
# class after patching it rather than declaring one.
